whats_new:
- Added: you can now paste an existing FoxPro/report query and ask IntraMind to translate it into a question it can answer.
- Fixed: total-sales style questions could give a different total depending on how the question was phrased, from two calculations that weren't always consistent with each other.
- Fixed: a name search like "vendors named Smith and Jones" now correctly matches either name, instead of requiring both to appear together.
- Fixed: folder/category filtering questions could occasionally match extra unrelated records due to a trailing-space mismatch.
- Fixed: warehouse questions now consistently use the correct warehouse code instead of occasionally mixing up code and name.
- Fixed: a follow-up "how does that compare to last year" question could silently reuse the wrong date range from an earlier question.
- Fixed: a question about negative on-hand inventory could produce a fabricated explanation instead of just reporting the numbers.
- Fixed: a P&L (profit & loss) question could report a mathematically inverted (sign-flipped) result in some phrasings.
- Fixed: an AP (vendor bill) line-item amount question could double-count in some cases due to a join key mismatch.
- Fixed: a per-invoice payment total could silently include allocations from a voided receipt.
- Fixed: several general-ledger and year-over-year questions that previously returned no answer, or an inconsistent one, now resolve correctly.
- Fixed: some questions that IntraMind could actually answer were being incorrectly refused.
- Fixed: a rare SQL error on some multi-part financial summary questions (e.g. a full P&L in one answer).
- Fixed: dashboard KPI drill-down could occasionally show a total that didn't match its own detail list.
- Fixed: dashboard KPI drill-down no longer crashes on an unexpected server response.
- Fixed: a stored-XSS issue in the KPI drill-down detail view.
- Fixed: the "What's New" popup could stretch to fill the whole screen on a long changelog.
- Fixed: "New Chat" could silently do nothing, and the starting suggestions could disappear permanently after your first message.
- Fixed: logging out no longer leaves the previous session's dashboard/chat data briefly visible to the next login.
- Fixed: a stale error or answer from a previous chat could occasionally appear after starting a new one.
- Fixed: submitting feedback always showed "Thanks," even when it silently failed to send.
- Fixed: several places where a slow or dropped network request could leave a button stuck disabled with no explanation, or hang indefinitely with no timeout.
- Security: query rate-limiting is now based on your real originating IP instead of a value that could be spoofed.
- Security: dashboard/report access now consistently enforces your module permissions everywhere, closing a couple of narrow gaps where a permission check could be skipped or accidentally treated as "allow" by default.
- Security: hardened the SQL safety filter against a couple of narrow ways a disallowed statement type could have slipped through.
